intro: Gerenzo's Mechanical Arm is the grafted prosthetic limb taken from the rogue engineer Gerenzo Wrenchwhistle in the Stonetalon Mountains. It serves as unmistakable proof of his demise for goblin operatives seeking to clear out competition.

p: Gerenzo Wrenchwhistle took self-modification to a grotesque extreme, grafting whirring gears and metal directly onto his failing body. Perched above Cragpool Lake, the renegade gnome replaced natural limbs with intricate machinery. When the goblin tinker Ziz Fizziks seeks Gerenzo's elimination to impress his superiors, this distinctive mechanical arm is the only trophy unique enough to serve as indisputable evidence of the engineer's death.
